verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud states you get a dedicated cluster with "no limits on records or operations" and "no plan-based cap on collection count or collection size," so there are no per-request or per-record pricing cliffs. Free GPL self-hosting of the full API offers a further cost-control path. Community notes that the whole index lives in memory suggest RAM-driven cluster costs will still rise as records grow. Missing for 10: published price points or a worked example of how cluster cost scales with record count and RAM, documentation of auto-scaling cost behavior, and independent user reports confirming costs stayed predictable at scale.
